title: Minkowski decompositions and universal equivariant deformations of toric pairs
summary: Let $X_σ$ be the affine normal toric variety associated with a full-dimensional strongly convex rational polyhedral cone $σ$, and let $m$ be a primitive degree with slice $P_m=σ\cap[m=1]$. We construct an explicit flat algebraic family whose completion is universal for equivariant deformations in all degrees $-jm$, $j\ge1$, simultaneously. We prove that the irreducible components of the reduced base correspond bijectively to maximal lattice-friendly Minkowski decompositions of $P_m$, and describe the induced family on each component.
